dispute_ticket.description: I waited at the pickup point and the rider never got in. I pressed no-show after more than 8 minutes. Please make sure the S$4.00 fee is paid to me.

chat_logs.content: I am at the carpark entrance, silver Prius.
Only coming down if you let me sit in front next to you, and you are my type btw. Give me your number and I will take the ride, my treat for drinks after.
Please get in the back seat as the app says. I will not share my number.
Then I wait here until you change your mind. You owe me a smile at least.

app_events.details: Driver tapped 'I'm Here'; GPS within 10 m of pickup point.
Driver cancelled; reason: rider_no_show. Wait counted from driver_arrived: 9 min 10 s. No-show fee S$4.00 applied.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from the driver_arrived event, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit counts: a wait of exactly 8 min 00 s meets it.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider counts as a no-show.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a no-show fee once it is charged.

expected_outcome.reason: On the numbers the fee looks due: the driver arrived at 21:00:00 and cancelled at 21:09:10, a wait of 9 min 10 s against the 8-minute threshold, fee S$4.00. But the chat shows why the rider did not board and how he behaved: at 21:03:00 he said he would only come down if he could sit in front, called her 'my type', asked for her number and offered drinks, and at 21:07:00 said she 'owed him a smile' after she declined at 21:03:40. Unwanted personal and romantic advances by the rider fall under Policy v2.1 s5.2, so a person decides this claim including the fee. No automated verdict or refund.
